主要内容: On January 21, 2020, Novavax, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement with the SEC, outlining the potential sale of up to $100 million in common stock through at-the-market offerings. The offering is governed by an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley FBR, Inc., dated January 21, 2020. The Company emphasized that it cannot guarantee the issuance of shares under this agreement. The filing also includes a legal opinion from Ropes & Gray LLP and a consent from the firm. The filing is an 8-K report, signed by John A. Herrmann III, Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary. The report is a legal requirement under U.S. securities law, though the content is not disclosed in the provided text.
